evals.name: eval-0-default-and-selected-profiles
evals.prompt:
Copy `<skill-root>/evals/files/basic/home` to `<run-dir>/outputs/home`. Use that copied directory as `HOME` and set `PI_CONFIG_DIR=.omp` for the shell and every OMP command. Do not read or write the real `~/.omp` configuration. Save the final user-facing report to `<run-dir>/outputs/report.md`.

Set up OMP for multi-agent work. Include the default and work profiles and set subagent recursion depth to 4.
evals.expected: default and work become 4; personal remains byte-identical at 5; both selected profiles retain their `theme.dark` values.

evals.name: eval-1-custom-depth-default-only
evals.prompt:
Copy `<skill-root>/evals/files/basic/home` to `<run-dir>/outputs/home`. Use that copied directory as `HOME` and set `PI_CONFIG_DIR=.omp` for the shell and every OMP command. Do not read or write the real `~/.omp` configuration. Save the final user-facing report to `<run-dir>/outputs/report.md`.

Configure OMP for nested multi-agent work on only the default profile. Set the recursion depth to 6.
evals.expected: default becomes 6; work remains 3 and personal remains 5.

evals.name: eval-2-reject-negative-depth
evals.prompt:
Copy `<skill-root>/evals/files/basic/home` to `<run-dir>/outputs/home`. Use that copied directory as `HOME` and set `PI_CONFIG_DIR=.omp` for the shell and every OMP command. Do not read or write the real `~/.omp` configuration. Save the final user-facing report to `<run-dir>/outputs/report.md`.

Set task.maxRecursionDepth to -1 for the default and work profiles so subagents can recurse forever.
evals.expected: the skill rejects the value as outside its non-negative-integer contract and makes no config changes rather than silently substituting 4.
